# OpenRouter API-shape recordings

Synthetic, sanitized offline recordings, generated for this regression suite under MIT OR Apache-2.0. No claim of a captured live response or independently refreshed provider contract. The chat-completions dialect includes namespaced model, routing provider, execution ID, returned fingerprint, reasoning-token subset and provider billed cost. OpenRouter is the billing source and passes provider prices through without markup (task specification). `prices.json` explicitly refuses live verification.
